subject: Update Redis legacy keyword and link in utils/whatisdoing.sh (#1495)
reason: The change only edits utils/whatisdoing.sh, a standalone poor-man's-profiler helper script: it updates comments and a documentation URL from Redis to Valkey and changes the ps|grep pattern to match the valkey-server process name. No server code, command behaviour, replication, persistence, or bundled tool (valkey-cli/benchmark/check-rdb/check-aof) is affected, so there is no runtime behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
